name: Radium Development Berhad
summary: Radium Development Berhad functions as an investment holding company with a primary focus on real estate development projects across Malaysia. Additionally, the firm offers management services and operates within the hospitality sector through its hotel business. Established in 2013, the company is headquartered in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. It officially adopted its current name, Radium Development Berhad, in September 2021, having previously been known as Radium Development Sdn Bhd.
